description: Manual identity disambiguation for legacy records that share one source URL but are DISTINCT logical entries (aggregator pages reporting several projects under one URL, or a DOI attached to two different papers). Each entry pins a curated unique legacy_source_key — an explicit human identity decision, recorded once; the stable-ID migration uses it verbatim (SourceIdentityKey 'legacy' namespace) instead of guessing or merging. Records that share identity AND canonical title are handled by the deterministic duplicate policy (first occurrence authoritative, later ones excluded as audited duplicates), not here.
